The main takeaway from our work is that

the sensitivity curves for spaceborne interferometric gravitational wave observatories can be computed using a relatively straightforward set of analytic formulae, provided that one takes into account the effects of the finite bandwidth of the detector and the finite time over which the detector must average to make a measurement.
the sensitivity curve of a spaceborne interferometer is a smooth, monotonically decreasing function of frequency.
